title: Toward Robust Characterization of Dynamic Binding Pockets: Lessons from the HBV Capsid Assembly Modulator Site
authors: Carolina Pérez-Segura; Liam W. Scott; Adam Zlotnick; Jodi A. Hadden-Perilla
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦HBV衣壳组装调节剂结合口袋的动态几何表征，虽涉及MD模拟和动态口袋分析，但对象为蛋白-小分子结合而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Protein function often depends on ligand binding pockets that fluctuate among conformational states, altering their size, shape, topology, and accessibility, yet quantitative comparison of these dynamic cavities remains challenging because their boundaries are often inherently ambiguous. The measure volinterior algorithm uses fuzzy-boundary detection to characterize enclosed molecular spaces; here, the hepatitis B virus (HBV) capsid assembly modulator (CAM) binding site is used as a model system to develop and validate a practical workflow for applying the method to dynamic protein binding pockets. The resulting methodology provides practical guidance for parameter selection and evaluation, establishes a standardized protocol for quantitative characterization of the HBV CAM pocket, and demonstrates robust, reproducible performance across conformational ensembles derived from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. More broadly, this work provides a reproducible strategy for adapting measure volinterior to other dynamic binding pockets, enabling consistent comparison of pocket geometry among independent structural studies. abstract_zh: 蛋白质功能通常依赖于配体结合口袋，这些口袋在构象状态间波动，改变其大小、形状、拓扑结构和可及性，然而对这些动态空腔的定量比较仍具挑战性，因为其边界往往本质上模糊不清。measure volinterior算法利用模糊边界检测来表征封闭分子空间；在此，乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）衣壳组装调节剂（CAM）结合位点被用作模型系统，以开发并验证将该方法应用于动态蛋白质结合口袋的实用工作流程。所形成的方法论为参数选择和评估提供了实用指导，建立了对HBV CAM口袋进行定量表征的标准化协议，并展示了在源自分子动力学（MD）模拟的构象系综中稳健、可重复的性能。更广泛地，这项工作为将measure volinterior适配于其他动态结合口袋提供了可复现的策略，使得独立结构研究之间能够对口袋几何形状进行一致比较。图形摘要
